NOORDWEEB / GOOD TO KNOW

How we work together.

A plain-language overview of the proposed service. Your written quote and project agreement set the final terms. Business registration details and formal terms are to be confirmed before public launch.

One build, an agreed scope

Choose one page with up to six sections for €950, or a small site of up to five pages for €1,650. The four optional extras are copy help (€250), longer menu entry (€100), one more language (€350) and one supported booking widget (€150). All prices are in euros, excluding applicable VAT. We confirm the project scope, price, tax treatment, timing, payment schedule and handover in writing before work starts.

What the starting price assumes

Package limits are shown in the configurator. Unless you choose an extra, you supply approved text, images, business details, translations and any required third-party accounts. Each website package includes two consolidated revision rounds. Larger design changes or new requirements need an agreed scope and price.

Keep it simple

We build static websites for small businesses. Simple contact, map and existing booking links are included, along with a menu PDF or up to six short menu/service entries. Online shops, on-site payments, customer accounts, custom booking systems, CMS dashboards and custom integrations are outside this offer. The language extra mirrors the agreed pages using translations you supply.

Provider costs

Domain registration, hosting, email services and booking platforms are separate from the website build and paid to their providers. Those accounts stay in your name. We help launch on one agreed static-compatible host and hand over the website files. We agree necessary provider costs before you commit. No maintenance subscription is required.

After launch

For a later update, new feature or fix, tell us what you need. We assess the work and agree a price before starting. Any obligations to correct the original delivery, support commitments, licensing and rights to deliverables are addressed in your project agreement.

Showroom designs

The showroom businesses, menus, rooms and prices within the demos are fictional. They illustrate design directions. Each demo is a single-page concept; the final website must include the pages and integrations specified in your quote.

Starting a conversation

A prepared project brief or tailored price request is not an order, a binding quotation or a submitted enquiry. Download or copy it to keep your ideas, then review and send it from your email app.

Contact: noordweeb@noordweeb.nl.
